text:
emma: Heads-up — prospect wants POC acceptance criteria + interoperability checklist for their security review. 2-week POC window, must include: latency/cost KPIs, network/VPC peering, KMS/HSM, SSO, and exportability of logs. Can we draft a short, actionable matrix by EOD?
raj: I can sketch the KPI targets and test harness. Proposed KPIs: 99th p50/p95 latency for 512-token gen, throughput (reqs/s), token cost estimate, model-quality baseline (BLEU/ROUGE or human eval set).
leah: Need pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for the POC (2 weeks, ~4k reqs/day). Also whether we can include a short credit offer.
mike: Networking checklist: VPC peering OR PrivateLink. If they pick VPC peering we need routing table entries + NAT/egress allowances. Firewall rules: allow outbound to our control plane on TCP 443 to *.redwood-inference.com.
olivia: Security notes: HSM option available for Private deployment only. For Hosted we provide bring-your-own-KMS via envelope encryption with CMK in their cloud. We'll attach KMS integration doc. Audit logs: we can export to their SIEM (S3/CloudWatch) — needs logging retention window defined.
raj: Interop checklist draft (short):
- Auth: SSO/OAuth + API key fallback
- Data flows: encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+), at-rest encryption on RDS + object storage
- Model artifacts: we provide model checksum + manifest for validation
- Quantization: we can serve q4/q8-compatible variants; quality delta tests required

raj: Quick config snippet I plan to include in the matrix for the ops runbook:
```
# example curl to test throughput
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-1.4","prompt":"<eval-prompt>","max_tokens":512}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
```
leah: Pricing ask — mike/raj what would be the marginal cost if they spin up Dedicated for 2 weeks vs hosted with committed burst? Need a rough number to propose (ballpark OK).
mike: Ballpark: Hosted (2w, 4k reqs/day, avg 150 tokens) ~= $X00 in usage. Dedicated (min reservation) has setup + pro-rated capacity; short POC likely more expensive unless we offer a trial credit or ephemeral dedicated node. Recommend we propose Hosted + reserved burst + 30% trial credits.
olivia: For questionnaire Q12 (KMS/HSM): Answer: "Hosted: envelope encryption with customer CMK; Private: HSM-backed KMS available; bring-your-own-HSM supported in private deployments." Will attach short statement and contact for legal.
sales-bot: Reminder: attach capability matrix CSV to thread for tracking (use sales-docs/pocs/piedmont-2026.csv).
emma: Can someone drop a concise acceptance criteria table (pass/fail) — I want 5 rows max: latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens, quality delta vs baseline, secure keying. I'll stitch into the RFI pack.
raj: I'll post a 1-page matrix in 30m. Will include: test harness commands, expected numeric targets, pass/fail thresholds, and sample data set link.
leah: I'll craft the pricing blurb + proposed credit. Will sync with legal on contract language for short-term dedicated if needed.
mike: If they want HSM-in-POC we need 48h lead time for provisioning on Private. Call that out.
olivia: Also call out SOC/ISO artifacts we can share (redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf).
emma: Awesome — thanks. If raj posts the matrix I'll attach and send to the customer by EOD. :thumbsup:
